candidates.transcript_evidence: Who was the first president of the United States of America?
candidates.description: 询问美国第一任总统是谁

candidates.transcript_evidence: Was it Thomas Jefferson, John Adams, George Washington, or James Madison?
candidates.description: 列举选项询问总统人选

candidates.transcript_evidence: So George Washington was the first president, as you said.
candidates.description: 确认乔治·华盛顿是第一任总统
说明约翰·亚当斯是第二任

candidates.transcript_evidence: Thomas Jefferson was the third, and James Madison was the fourth.
candidates.description: 说明托马斯·杰斐逊和詹姆斯·麦迪逊是第三、四任

candidates.transcript_evidence: But they were all involved in the Declaration of Independence and the American Revolution.
candidates.description: 指出他们都参与了独立宣言和美国革命

limitations: 转录中说话者归属未知，无法分配具体身份
无词句时间戳，时间信息缺失
